sources.supports: OpenAI's official GPT-5.1 model page lists cached input at $0.125 per million tokens.

sources.quote:
### Nov 13

Feature · Model: gpt-5.1 · Model: gpt-5.1-codex · Model: gpt-5.1-chat-latest · Model: gpt-5.1-codex-mini · API: v1/responses · API: v1/chat/completions

Released [GPT-5.1](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.1), the newest flagship model in the GPT-5 model family.
sources.supports: OpenAI's changelog says GPT-5.1 was released on Nov 13, anchoring the official model pricing record to its launch period.

notes: OpenAI's official model page gives the cached input rate as $0.125, matching the post-change value. The $0.13 earlier value appears to be an inaccurate rounding in models.dev; no provider source located states a later effective date for a change, so no date is assigned.
